research_topic: Graph Neural Network Long-Range Dependency Representation Enhancement Create a Hierarchical Graph Neural Network (HGNN) integrating GraphTransformer with hierarchical message passing to improve graph classification accuracy by 15% and long-range dependency capture ability by 20% on TUDataset PROTEINS/IMDB-BINARY (https://chrsmrrs.github.io/datasets/), OGB ogbg-molhiv (https://ogb.stanford.edu/), and Long Range Graph Benchmark, compared against GCN, GAT, GraphSAINT, and DiffPool baselines.
